findings.location: content.body.ruleUk: "Для руху «куди» вживають інший прийменник — його вивчатимемо в A1-04."
findings.description: The unrestricted statement wrongly excludes en from movement towards a destination. Peninsular Spanish also uses constructions such as entrar en la habitación.
findings.suggestion: Limit the preview to the construction being introduced later, for example: "Напрямок із дієсловом ir передає прийменник a: ir a Madrid. Це вивчатимемо в A1-04."

items.reviewerAnswer: en casa; en la mesa; en Madrid; en el piso.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «entrar», destination complements with en or a (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[0]: "Estamos buenos." is marked incorrect; task.prompt[0] gives "У нас усе добре" without specifying general well-being versus health or recovery.
findings.description: Estar bueno has a health/recovery meaning as well as other meanings. Whether this reviewed alternative is unsuitable depends on the intended situation, which the prompt does not fix. Bueno is a separate adjective, not an inflected form of bien.
findings.suggestion: Specify the intended situation and meaning, then reassess this alternative. Explain the distinction between bien and bueno rather than relying only on the invariability of bien.

items.reviewerAnswer: Estamos bien; optionally Nosotros/Nosotras estamos bien. Estamos buenos is also possible if the intended statement specifically concerns being healthy or recovered.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entry «bueno», health sense and its use with estar (from memory).
Course contract rule 3; the supplied verdict instructions require uncertain for judgments that depend on unspecified context.
